shortDescription: Copper output in Chile, the world's largest producer of the metal, fell 9.4% year-on-year in July to 403,424 metric tons, statistics agency INE said on Monday.Manufacturing production in the Andean nation was down 4.9% in the month on a yearly basis, the agency added.

Manufacturing production in the Andean nation was down 4.9% in the month on a yearly basis, the agency added.
